item.title: Coldcard hardware wallet flaw exploited to sweep 594 BTC ($38M) from roughly 500 wallets, raising questions over key-generation security.
U.S. federal agencies missed the GENIUS Act's July 18 deadline to finalize stablecoin rules; Treasury has opened a second comment round.
BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, Goldman Sachs and SoFi publicly endorsed the U.S. CLARITY Act digital-asset framework bill.
MiCA's transitional period ended July 1, triggering USDT delistings on EU exchanges as tokenized equity volumes hit a record $11.3B.
Q2 2026 set a record as crypto's most-hacked quarter with 83 incidents totaling $755M in losses, led by bridge exploits.
SEC and CFTC opened joint public consultation on aligning portfolio margin rules across securities and crypto derivatives markets.
JPMorgan will accept BlackRock's IBIT Bitcoin ETF shares as eligible loan collateral, expanding institutional crypto liquidity.
UK FCA proposed mandatory client-asset segregation and private-key safeguards for crypto firms under the existing CASS framework.
Ostium lost $18M in an oracle-manipulation attack on July 15, extending a wave of price-feed exploits targeting DeFi protocols.
BIS found a $3.5B stablecoin inflow moved three-month Treasury bill yields by four basis points within 10 days.
SEC ordered Bloom Protocol to register its BLT token as a security or face a $31M civil penalty.
Securitize and Computershare announced a partnership enabling onchain settlement for U.S. equities, a market valued at roughly $70T.
Tether reported $1.5B operating profit in Q2 2026 and added 14 metric tons of gold and approximately 1,800 BTC to its reserves.
Kraken launched CFTC-regulated perpetual futures for U.S. clients, extending regulated crypto derivatives trading onshore.
European regulators opened the MiCA 2.0 review consultation, beginning the first formal revision of the bloc's landmark crypto rulebook.
